stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Prediction can help people notice problems early.”?
options: Technology can notice signals, but humans must decide what action to take.
A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.
But when dealing with humans, a prediction must leave space for story.
Sometimes an object becomes important because of the feelings people leave there.
